history.overview: The Trial of Fear is designed to break the will of combatants through terror, isolation, and Discord manifestations.

timeline.name: Fear Arena Design
timeline.description: Muramite overseers commissioned an arena focused on psychological trials.

timeline.name: Isolation Protocols
timeline.description: Isolation chambers were added to separate combatants and induce panic.

timeline.name: Dragorn Fear Trials
timeline.description: Dragorn captives were forced into fear scenarios to test their resolve.

timeline.name: Discord Terror Amplification
timeline.description: Terror pylons were installed to amplify Discord‑induced dread.
